info.description:
API test cases mapped from unit test plan
TC_QUIZ_001-044 | TC_AI_001-006 | TC_QB_001-009 | TC_QST_001-014

=== QUICK START ===
1. Set collection variable  baseUrl = http://localhost:8888
2. Set collection variable  classId = <ID of a class teacher belongs to>
3. Set collection variable  uploadedFileUrl = <URL of a PDF file>
4. Run folder '1. Authentication' → tokens are auto-saved
5. Run folders in order: 1-Auth, 2-QB, 3-AI, 4-Quiz CRUD, 5-Quiz Q, 6-Class Assign, 7-Submit, 8-View Sub, 9-Stats, 10-Question

=== KNOWN BUGS (marked [KNOWN BUG]) ===
- TC_QUIZ_003, TC_QUIZ_010 : blank title not rejected
- TC_QB_002               : blank bank title not rejected
- TC_QST_002/003/004      : blank content not rejected
- TC_QUIZ_039, TC_QUIZ_040: division-by-zero in statistics
